details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant downturn, with Bitcoin dropping below $78,000 and approximately $580 million in long positions liquidated across the market within 24 hours. Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $1 billion in net outflows over the past week, ending a six-week inflow streak. This bearish trend is largely attributed to rising US Treasury yields, persistent inflation fears, and a broader global bond sell-off. Additionally, Ether fell to a one-year low against Bitcoin amid increasing exchange inflows, suggesting a rotation of capital towards BTC.
title: Crypto Market Plunges, $580M Liquidated, Bitcoin ETFs See $1B Outflows

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) has advanced through the US Senate Banking Committee with a bipartisan vote of 15-9. This legislative progress is a positive step towards establishing clearer regulatory guidelines for the cryptocurrency sector in the United States.
title: US Senate Committee Advances CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulatory Clarity

details: The Ethereum Foundation has introduced an open-source "Clear Signing" standard, which includes ERC-7730 and ERC-8176. This initiative aims to enhance security and user experience by presenting transaction details in human-readable text, thereby reducing the risks associated with blind signing.
title: Ethereum Launches "Clear Signing" Standard to Boost Transaction Security

details: Amidst a period of underperformance for Ethereum (ETH), the institutional entity Bitmine has significantly increased its holdings by purchasing 89,026 ETH, valued at $197.64 million. This latest acquisition brings Bitmine's total Ethereum reserves to 2.59 million ETH.
title: Bitmine Accumulates $197M in ETH, Boosting Total Holdings to 2.59M
